how-22-02-specimen.page: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the bee and the flower, then tap 3 things you notice.
how-22-02-specimen.say: Press Inspect specimen. Move the magnifying lens over the bee and the flower, then tap three things you notice.

how-22-02-compare.page: Put the box under one tray and the lamp under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap and test again.
how-22-02-compare.say: Put the box under one tray and the lamp under the other: drag them, or tap one, then a tray. Press Run the test. Then swap and test again.

how-22-02-wall.page: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.
how-22-02-wall.say: First, make a prediction. Then brush the glowing stop: drag across it (or tap it again and again) until the place shows.

how-22-02-det.page: Pick 3 case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it lost. Predict which fix works, and watch the place today appear.
how-22-02-det.say: Pick three case files, one at a time. Tap a clue, then pick what it lost. Predict which fix works, and watch the place today appear.

how-22-02-partc.page: Draw the meadow before and after the parking lot. Label what changed, and one living thing that was affected.
how-22-02-partc.say: Draw the meadow before and after the parking lot. Label what changed, and one living thing that was affected.
